column3: “The sum” is rendered “the main point,” and “sat down” “has taken His seat.”
NASB follows the critical text (“those who offer,” without “the priests”); it adds “at all.”
“Divinely instructed” is rendered “warned by God,” and “complete” “erect.” The quotation is in capitals.
“Ratify” is rendered “effect,” and NASB adds “WHEN.” The quotation is in capitals.
NASB follows the critical text (“fellow citizen”; “from the least to the greatest of them”).
NASB follows the critical text, without “and their lawless deeds.”
NASB supplies “A new covenant”; “near vanishing” is rendered “ready to disappear.”
